No warm run yet: a warm run compares with cpu_cold (lax) until one is recorded. Re-record with `python3 test/lib/gates.py record gate-times.json --baseline test/duration-baseline-ci.json` from the gate-times artifact of a green CI run (docs/dev/test-profile.md). 2026-11-25 (test-speed2): `check`'s pin-audit smoke became the test-pin-smoke gate; until a sharded run is recorded, their cold numbers are check's 09acff6b numbers split by the dev host's measured shares (pin smoke 192 of 280 CPU s, 108 of 182 s wall). The shards record as four gate-times-<shard> artifacts: `gh run download <id> -p 'gate-times-*'` then `gates.py record gate-times-*/gate-times.json`.
